content: {"rule": "K-C", "applies": "yes", "applies_why": "The text weighs the challenger's seed/loins chain against the defender's chain in a collision over a link, which is exactly the chain-against-chain weighing K-C governs.", "verdict": "BREACH", "quote": "the challenger's seed/loins chain is footed but does not name Joseph as the begetter", "rule_words": "the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse; that no one of them states the contrary in its own words is the stating-verse test DG-61 retires, at a judge's seat as at a debater's, for either side", "room": "Rule phrase 'that no one of them states the contrary in its own words is the stating-verse test DG-61 retires... for either side': read (1) as catching the judge faulting a chain it just affirmed as footed for lacking an explicit naming of Joseph, or (2) as not catching it because 'does not name' merely notes the chain has no footed link for the begetter at all, a footing observation K-C permits; I weighed reading (1) because the judge affirmed 'is footed' first and then made the naming-absence the chain's defect.", "why": "Having affirmed the challenger's chain was footed, the judge still offset it because it does not name Joseph as the begetter, letting the absence of an in-so-many-words statement do deciding work that K-C retires for either side."}
